name: Pane
description: Represents a pane of a window.
remarks: Pane objects exist only for worksheets and Microsoft Excel 4.0 macro sheets. The Pane object is a member of the Panes collection. The Panes collection contains all of the panes shown in a single window.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the index number of the object within the collection of similar objects.

properties.name: ScrollColumn
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of the leftmost column in the pane or window. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ScrollRow
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of the row that appears at the top of the pane or window. Read/write Long.

properties.name: VisibleRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range of cells that are visible in the window or pane. If a column or row is partially visible, it's included in the range. Read-only.

methods.name: LargeScroll
methods.signature: LargeScroll([Down As Variant], [Up As Variant], [ToRight As Variant], [ToLeft As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Scrolls the contents of the window by pages.

parameters.name: Down
parameters.description: The number of pages to scroll the contents down.

parameters.name: Up
parameters.description: The number of pages to scroll the contents up.

parameters.name: ToRight
parameters.description: The number of pages to scroll the contents to the right.

parameters.name: ToLeft
parameters.description: The number of pages to scroll the contents to the left.

methods.name: SmallScroll
methods.signature: SmallScroll([Down As Variant], [Up As Variant], [ToRight As Variant], [ToLeft As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Scrolls the contents of the window by rows or columns.

parameters.name: Down
parameters.description: The number of rows to scroll the contents down.

parameters.name: Up
parameters.description: The number of rows to scroll the contents up.

parameters.name: ToRight
parameters.description: The number of columns to scroll the contents to the right.

parameters.name: ToLeft
parameters.description: The number of columns to scroll the contents to the left.

methods.name: ScrollIntoView
methods.signature: ScrollIntoView(Left As Long, Top As Long, Width As Long, Height As Long, [Start As Variant])
methods.description: Scrolls the document window so that the contents of a specified rectangular area are displayed in either the upper-left or lower-right corner of the document window or pane (depending on the value of the _Start_ argument).

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The horizontal position of the rectangle (in points) from the left edge of the document window or pane.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The vertical position of the rectangle (in points) from the top of the document window or pane.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the rectangle, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the rectangle, in points.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: True to have the upper-left corner of the rectangle appear in the upper-left corner of the document window or pane. False to have the lower-right corner of the rectangle appear in the lower-right corner of the document window or pane. The default value is True.

methods.name: PointsToScreenPixelsX
methods.description: Returns or sets a pixel point on the screen.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: Location of the pixel on the screen.

methods.name: PointsToScreenPixelsY
methods.description: Returns or sets the location of the pixel on the screen.
